page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u1-c1m8.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 12 physical cores with 12 vCPUs, 96.0 GB of system memory, and a 4 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware.

Benchmark results indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, including stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, fall into the bottom 25% tier. However, multi-core performance, such as Geekbench multi-core and Passmark CPU scores, reaches average levels. Memory bandwidth tests, both cached and uncached, consistently register in the middle 50% tier, with uncached read speeds at 72.4 GB/sec and write speeds at 45.95 GB/sec.

The 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high single-threaded CPU performance. Database operations, Redis SET operations averaging 10.27 million operations per second, and static web serving are supported at average performance levels. Conversely, tasks requiring heavy single-core processing or medium-to-large language model inference show performance limitations, with 7B model prompt processing falling into the bottom 10% tier.
